notes: Single cross-surface data-retention contract for Blueprint (GCP project blueprint-8c1ca).
Raw capture bundles are AUTHORITATIVE and are the longest-lived data class; every other
class (derived, hosted, financial, PII, operational, cache) is retained no longer than raw,
and derived/hosted artifacts are retained strictly shorter than raw.
enforced_by declares the REAL enforcement mechanism per entry; some entries are enforced by
committed config (gcs_lifecycle / firestore_ttl) and some are documented human/scheduled steps
(scheduled_job / manual_review). See policy_doc for the apply commands and the human steps.

storage_prefixes.note: Raw capture truth (scenes/{sceneId}/captures/{captureId}/raw/...). Lifecycle (R042) tiers NEARLINE@90d, COLDLINE@365d, Delete@3650d. Never deleted before the 7-year floor.
Hosted/derived canonical world-model artifacts. Regenerable from raw; kept 2y for hosted runtime + buyer access.
Delivered buyer package bundles (signed-URL source, see arena_package_delivery_gcs.py). Derived; 1y covers delivery + dispute window.

Intermediate pipeline outputs live mid-path under scenes/.../pipeline/. GCS lifecycle can only prefix-match the START of an object name, so these cannot be isolated by a bucket lifecycle rule and are swept by a scheduled cleanup job (documented human/ops step). Regenerable from raw.

firestore_collections.note: Creator payout ledger (Stripe references, amounts). 7-year tax/financial retention; never auto-deleted.
Buyer purchase/order records. 7-year tax/financial retention; never auto-deleted.
Buyer access grants to hosted world models. Retained 2y after revocation for audit/dispute; entitlement != financial ledger.
Creator/supply waitlist leads (email, phone, location). 12-month PII retention via Firestore TTL.
Buyer inbound demand leads (contact info, site context). 12-month PII retention via Firestore TTL.
General contact submissions (name, email, company, message). 24-month PII retention via Firestore TTL.
Derived enrichment tied to a source lead. Deleted when the source lead is deleted; capped at the source PII retention.
Curated capture opportunities / assignment context. 2y operational retention.

Creator capture METADATA records. Indefinite while commercially active; 90d after delisting/rejection. Deleting this record does NOT delete raw capture truth in GCS (scenes/), which keeps its own 10-year floor.
Ephemeral hosted world-model runtime sessions. Short-lived; expired via Firestore TTL.
Server control-plane action/audit trail. 2y retention swept by a scheduled job.

default_firestore_retention.note: Any Firestore collection not explicitly listed above inherits this default: 2-year review-then-delete. Add an explicit entry to override.
